title: UF250 post-candidate WL k-class / orbit correspondence and future-course hint

parser_failure_clarification.meaning: The <=150 defect affected only the original independent checker parser. It did not truncate, cap, or otherwise restrict the completed UF250 candidate computation.

posthoc_structural_observation.warning: This correspondence was inspected after the candidate result was visible. It is an architectural hint, not a preregistered success metric and not evidence that may be promoted on this same panel.

finite_correspondence_summary.nontrivial_side: 3/3 sources with nontrivial WL structure had E3 generator edges matching the same variable cell
finite_correspondence_summary.trivial_side: 17/17 remaining sources had no nontrivial WL class and no E3 generator edge

architectural_readout.primary_signal: On this finite panel, the bottleneck appears to have shifted from detecting nontrivial exchangeability structure to turning the detected structure into an admissible compact polynomial closure/certificate.
architectural_readout.detector_signal: WL1 and WL2 diagonal refinement isolated exactly the three sources on which frozen E3 found nontrivial generator edges.
architectural_readout.current_selector_limitation: The frozen selector recognizes only one unique size-2 class, so the K3 structures in UF250_016 and UF250_018 are deliberately outside the selector grammar rather than selector misses.
architectural_readout.resource_bottleneck: All three structurally interesting cases remained without E3 solver authority because quotient counting exceeded the frozen budget; UF250_020 was additionally outside the explicit direct-exact scope theorem resource bound.

future_hypothesis.name: WL_KCLASS_ORBIT_CELL_SELECTOR
future_hypothesis.core_question: If frozen 1-WL and 2-WL diagonal refinement agree on one nontrivial variable class C of size k>=2, can a polynomially checkable exact generator certificate establish the permutation action on C without a global all-transpositions search?

subtargets.goal: Determine whether O(k) explicitly chosen transpositions, such as a star or adjacent generating set, suffice to certify full S_k action when each generator is independently verified as an exact automorphism.
subtargets.requirement: Proof must bind exact semantics and total polynomial verification cost; no inference from the UF250 K3 examples alone.

subtargets.goal: For a certified full symmetric action on a class C of size k, exploit the fact that assignments restricted to C have at most k+1 Hamming-weight orbits instead of 2^k raw assignments.
subtargets.requirement: Show how this compression composes with the rest of the formula without hidden exponential products or loss of SAT equivalence.

subtargets.goal: Replace hundreds-of-millions-scale quotient-state enumeration by a symbolic certificate or boundary relation whose construction, solve, reconstruction, and verification are all polynomial in input length.
subtargets.requirement: No new unbounded recursion, full cube enumeration, posthoc threshold, or synthetic blocker.

subtargets.goal: Characterize when several symmetric classes can be composed without a product of orbit counts becoming exponential.
subtargets.requirement: A bounded-number-of-classes result must not be promoted to arbitrary SAT.

rationale: The repaired checker may confirm the candidate, reveal a real mismatch, or expose another implementation defect; each outcome changes the correct next scientific obligation.
Starting a new tuned mechanism before reconciliation would mix posthoc UF250 observations with unresolved authority.
Theory-only formalization and preregistration drafts are allowed while waiting, but no new panel should be executed with a mechanism derived from these posthoc observations.
after_reconciliation_pass: Freeze UF250 as independently reproduced with its original claim ceiling.
Create a new preregistration for WL_KCLASS_ORBIT_CELL_SELECTOR or a narrower generator-certificate theorem.
Use a genuinely untouched out-of-family panel for the first scientific test of the new k-class mechanism.
Keep UF250 only as the discovery panel, never as confirmation for the new hypothesis.
after_reconciliation_mismatch: Freeze the mismatch as the primary result.
Localize the first differing prediction/ground-truth receipt before any new mechanism work.
Do not use the k-class observation for promotion until candidate/checker disagreement is resolved.
